tools.name: linear_generateOAuthApplicationSetup
tools.description: Generate an official Linear OAuth application manifest and a human-confirmed setup URL. This does not create the application; an authorized workspace admin or owner must review and submit it in Linear.

name.description: OAuth client name. Must not contain "Linear" or an http(s) URL.

tools.name: linear_generateOAuthAuthorizationUrl
tools.description: Generate a Linear OAuth authorization URL. Scopes are requested during authorization; this tool does not create, grant, approve, persist, or modify scopes. Actor/scope rules: with actor: "app" the admin scope is rejected, and the agent-only scopes (app:assignable, app:mentionable, customer:read, customer:write, initiative:read, initiative:write) require actor: "app".

scopes.description: Scopes to request. The read scope is always included. app:assignable, app:mentionable, customer:*, and initiative:* scopes require actor: "app"; admin is unavailable with actor: "app".

codeChallenge.description: RFC 7636 S256 PKCE challenge: exactly 43 base64url characters. The method is set to S256 automatically.

tools.name: linear_createOAuthClientCredentialsToken
tools.description: Issue a scoped Linear app-actor access token through the client_credentials grant for server-to-server pipelines. The token is returned once, has no refresh token, and is normally valid for 30 days. If the requested scope set differs from existing app-actor tokens, Linear revokes those existing tokens.

clientSecret.description: The OAuth application client secret. It is sent only to Linear's token endpoint.

scopes.description: Scopes for the app-actor token. The read scope is always included.

confirmSecretExposure.description: Must be true to acknowledge that a one-time secret will be returned in the MCP tool result.

confirmScopeChangeRisk.description: Must be true to acknowledge that requesting a different scope set revokes existing app-actor tokens for this OAuth application.

tools.name: linear_getManagedOAuthApplications
tools.description: List alpha child OAuth applications owned by the calling OAuth application. This is not a workspace-wide OAuth application admin listing and does not work as generic scope CRUD.

tools.name: linear_getManagedOAuthApplicationById
tools.description: Get an alpha child OAuth application owned by the calling OAuth application. It cannot retrieve an arbitrary workspace OAuth application.

tools.name: linear_createManagedOAuthApplication
tools.description: Create an alpha child OAuth application owned by the calling OAuth application. This is not the human setup flow and returns one-time client and optional webhook secrets in the MCP result. It cannot set distribution or pre-grant OAuth scopes.

name.description: OAuth client name. Must not contain "Linear" or an http(s) URL.

confirmSecretExposure.description: Must be true to acknowledge that a one-time secret will be returned in the MCP tool result.

tools.name: linear_updateManagedOAuthApplication
tools.description: Update metadata, grant capabilities, or webhook configuration for an alpha child app owned by the calling OAuth application. This does not grant or approve token scopes.

name.description: OAuth client name. Must not contain "Linear" or an http(s) URL.

tools.name: linear_archiveManagedOAuthApplication
tools.description: Archive an alpha child OAuth application owned by the calling OAuth application. This does not revoke an unrelated authorized application.

tools.name: linear_rotateManagedOAuthApplicationSecret
tools.description: Rotate the client secret of an alpha child app owned by the calling OAuth application. The new one-time secret is exposed in the MCP result and existing client-credentials tokens may be invalidated.

confirmSecretExposure.description: Must be true to acknowledge that a one-time secret will be returned in the MCP tool result.

tools.name: linear_rotateManagedOAuthApplicationWebhookSecret
tools.description: Rotate the webhook signing secret of an alpha child app owned by the calling OAuth application. The new one-time secret is exposed in the MCP result.

confirmSecretExposure.description: Must be true to acknowledge that a one-time secret will be returned in the MCP tool result.
